faqSection.subdescription: Everything you need to know about working with Orvexiq Lab.

items.question: What types of projects do you work on?
items.answer: We work on digital products that solve real problems — from AI-powered platforms and SaaS products to enterprise systems, marketplaces, and mobile applications.

items.question: Do you work with existing product teams?
items.answer: Yes. We work alongside in-house designers, engineers and product managers, and we adapt to how your team already works rather than replacing your process.

items.question: Do you provide both design and development?
items.answer: We lead product strategy and design end to end, and we stay through build so what ships matches what was designed rather than an approximation of it.

items.question: Do you build design systems?
items.answer: Design systems are a core part of what we do — tokens, components and documentation built so the work holds up after handoff instead of drifting.

items.question: How does a typical project engagement work?
items.answer: Every engagement runs through the same four stages: discover, define, design and build, then evolve. You always know what is happening and what comes next.

items.question: How can we start a project?
items.answer: Tell us the problem you are trying to solve. We come back with how we would approach it — not a pitch deck — and we take it from there.
